nodes.title: Nice rational correspondence
nodes.statement: Let X/Q be smooth, proper and geometrically connected, of genus g>1, with b in X(Q). In C=Pic(X×X)⊗Q let P be the sum of the two pullback subspaces. A correspondence Z is nice when swap*Z−Z belongs to P, its H1⊗H1 Kunneth component cl(Z) is nonzero, and the induced endomorphism E_Z of H1 has trace zero. Nontrivial means nonzero in this component, not merely a nonzero divisor or Picard class. The same predicate applies after scalar extension, but a p-adic class is not thereby a rational correspondence.

Rational coefficients permit subtracting the scalar trace part.
proofSteps: Form the pullback subspace in the rational Picard group and impose symmetry in its quotient.
Extract the H1⊗H1 component; impose its nonvanishing and trace zero. On supplied native modules the three conditions are an explicit predicate.

nodes.title: Primitive class and trace criterion
nodes.statement: For a symmetric rational correspondence Z on X whose Jacobian is absolutely simple, its Kunneth tensor is alternating (with the graded Kunneth sign). Its cup product is zero exactly when E_Z has trace zero, under the trace H2(X)(1)≅coefficient field. Consequently Z is nice exactly when cl(Z) is nonzero and cup(cl(Z))=0. The nonzero qualification is essential; the zero correspondence satisfies the latter equation alone.

nodes.title: Quadratic Chabauty rank criterion
nodes.statement: Let X/Q be smooth, projective and geometrically connected with genus g>1 and rational basepoint, J its Jacobian, p a prime of good reduction, r=rank J(Q), and rho_Q=rank NS(J/Q). With the NC.4 Selmer locus defined by crystalline conditions at p, actual local Kummer images at all bad places and projection to the global Mordell–Weil Kummer image, r<g+rho_Q−1 implies X(Qp)_2 is finite. It contains X(Q). No equality between global H1_f(G_T,V) and J(Q)⊗Qp, no ordinary-reduction hypothesis and no replacement of rho_Q by the geometric Picard number are assumed.
hypotheses: Use p-adic coefficients and the reduced Selmer variety convention of BD I §2.3, as fixed in NC.4.
The number field is Q; the extra unit and splitting hypotheses for other fields are outside this selected theorem.
proofSteps: From A2/A6 import rational NS and its symmetric-Hom injection and finite rank. Primitive rational NS classes form a space of dimension rho_Q−1 after removing the theta/trace direction.

Push U2 to an extension of V by rho_Q−1 Tate lines. The global crystalline/unramified Tate-line kernel has dimension zero over Q, using the S-unit/Kummer and local conditions; finite bad Kummer images contribute no dimension. The Mordell–Weil cut bounds the global Selmer dimension by r.

The local crystalline quotient has dimension g+rho_Q−1 by strict extension classification and the Bloch–Kato dimension formula. The strict inequality gives non-dominance. Import NC.4 discwise density and analytic finiteness to conclude.
